Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. The hosts have put in a strong display and that sees them take a lead in this series. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, would look to bounce back in the next game. The fourth T20I will be played on Thursday, 2nd September at Bready. The first ball will be bowled at 3 pm local (2 pm GMT) but our buildup will begin well in advance. Please do join us for the same. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, says that it was a complete performance from the team. Tells that the wicket played very differently than he expected. Credits Stirling for his amazing batting and says that he deserves that century. Praises Getkate as well for supporting Stirling. Mentions that he is happy for Mark Adair as he is coming in after his injury. Says that they will look to win the series and go ahead for Thursday's game with a positive mindset.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, says that they did well to restrict Ireland inside the first ten overs but then got attacked in the last six-seven overs. Mentions that Stirling is one of the guys that gives Ireland the foundation and if you don't get him out, he will come hard at you. Tells that they have to find a way to get through the first six overs with the bat.

Paul Stirling is the Player of the Match! He says that it was a tough and tricky start and it was a big toss to lose. Mentions that he just looked to clear the boundaries and wasn't personally aiming for the century. Tells that he missed out on a couple of deliveries but will avoid that ahead. Says that the win shows a lot about the character of the team.

Ireland will be pretty pleased with how they have fared in this game. There were spells in between where it looked like the visitors were gaining some momentum, but the Irish lads did well in those moments to put a halt to the Zimbabwean charge. Benjamin White, Shane Getkate, Josh Little, and Mark Adair were in the wickets column, as they ended with at least 2 wickets to their name. Adair, though, ended with 3 to his name and had a good game. They were pretty clinical with their work out on the field too. Overall, they put in a complete display and will be happy to take a lead in this series.

The Zimbabwean openers, Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere, started off in a positive manner as they looked to attack the loose balls and start the Powerplay with a bang. That blast only lasted for a short while as both openers were sent back shortly after. After that, wickets kept falling and none of the batters were able to settle down and play a measured knock. Skipper, Craig Ervine and Ryan Burl did show some fight, but they needed assistance from the other batters, which they never got, and in the end, they fell short by 40 runs.

A convincing victory for Ireland and they take a 2-1 lead in this 5-game T20I series. They put up a good total on board, followed that up with a strong bowling display which sees them take a deserved lead in this series. Zimbabwe showed glimpses of showing some fight, but, they have missed out, in the end, as they lose this game by 40 runs.

OUT! RICHARD NGARAVA IS RUN OUT! That is the end of the game. Fuller in length on leg, Chatara squeezes it out to mid-wicket. He takes off for a single but then says no. In the meantime, Richard Ngarava is already halfway down the track. He tries to get back to the crease but Shane Getkate picks up the ball and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. IRELAND WIN BY 40 RUNS.
Good-length ball outside off, Chatara looks to cut but misses.
On a length around off, Tendai Chatara cuts it through point for a single.
On the pads, Ngarava looks to work it on the leg side but inside-edges it to fine leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Mark Adair gets his third wicket. He serves a short-of-a-length ball on leg, Ryan Burl goes for the pull shot, but he holes out to the fine leg fielder where Simi Singh takes a good low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Richard Ngarava is the last man walking out!
On off, guided to third man for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Chatara looks to play it away from the body and misses.

Just short of the deep square leg fielder. Fuller in length, on leg. Ryan Burl whips it towards deep square leg. The fielder there runs ahead in an attempt to catch the ball but it falls just short of him. A run taken.
On leg, Chatara tucks it to short fine leg. He takes off for a single but is sent back by Burl. 45 needed from 18 balls.
A low full toss outside off, Burl smashes it to wide of long off but only for a single.
Full again on middle and leg, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Burl drags it down to long on for one.
SIX! SLAMMED! Right in the slot, on off. Ryan Burl stands tall and hammers it over long on for a maximum. That went miles over.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length ball well outside off, Ryan Burl gets into the line of the ball and laps it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Chatara hits it to cover. 58 needed from 24 balls.

OUT! TIMBER! Josh Little bags his second. A touch fuller and on off, Wellington Masakadza looks to work it on the leg side and exposes his stumps. He misses and the ball skids through to rattle the stumps.

Good-length ball on middle, Burl defends it down onto the deck. The batters take off for a quick single. Little quickly runs and kicks the ball and hits the stumps. Wellington Masakadza was well in though.
The new batter walks in. It is Tendai Chatara!
Fuller in length, outside off. Burl again swings his bat and again fails to connect.
FOUR! Streaky! Short of a length, outside off. Ryan Burl looks to guide it to third man but miscues. The ball goes off the top edge over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off. Ryan Burl advances down the track and swings his bat but only connects it with thin air around him.
Around off, pushed through mid off for one. 63 more needed in 30 balls!
Leg bye. Outside off, Wellington Masakadza steps out but misses his shot. The ball takes the pad and goes to the off side, for a leg bye.
Loopy, outside off, Wellington Masakadza gets low and drags his sweep to deep mid-wicket and the man in the deep does well to dive and stop the ball. Saves a couple of runs for his side.
Floats it up, outside off, pushed through covers for one.
Around off, flatter too, punched off the back foot through covers and the batters come back for the second.
Shortish, outside off, Burl looks to slash it away but he misses.
Good-length ball on middle, worked through square leg and one more run is taken.
Around off, on a length, worked through mid on for a run.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, Wellington Masakadza looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Back of a length, around off, worked to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller, outside off, Wellington Masakadza swings at this but misses.
Wellington Masakadza is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED! That should be the game. The skipper of Zimbabwe has to head back and he looked like the last hope for the visitors to win this game. Now, with him gone, the game looks to be in Ireland's grasp. On a length, around middle and leg, the ball stays slightly low as Craig Ervine looks to force this through the leg side but misses. The furniture behind takes a beating. 75 needed in 41 balls!
Shane Getkate is back on. His figures read 2-0-14-1.
Around off, pushed through mid off for a run.
FOUR! The skipper gets a boundary now. Made it look easy. Floated, around off, Craig Ervine lofts this one over the covers for a boundary.
Outside off, Burl steers it to deep cover for a single this time.
Three dots in a row! Loopy ball, full and on off. Burl pushes it to mid off.
Loopy ball on off, punched to the right of the bowler.
Tossed it up, outside off. Burl looks to cut it away but misses.
Simi Singh comes back on.
Around off, pushed through covers for a run.
On a length on off, kept out.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Ryan Burl walks out to bat at No.8.

OUT! CAUGHT! The sixth one falls and Mark Adair strikes. A slower ball, around off, on a length, Luke Jongwe looks to play this to the leg side, but is through his shot early. The outside edge is induced and the ball lobs up behind, near the keeper. Neil Rock moves to his right and takes this dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Full-length ball, around off, hit down to long on for one.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Another one. Ervine is leading the charge. Shortish, outside off, Craig Ervine slashes this one through point for a boundary.
Around off, pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! Shortish, around off, Luke Jongwe slaps this one through point. Much needed for Zimbabwe!
Flatter, outside off, Craig Ervine looks to slash but misses as the ball takes the inside edge to fine leg for one.
On middle, hit to deep mid-wicket for one.
Luke Jongwe is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Benjamin White strikes and gets his second wicket. Shumba walks back and Zimbabwe's run chase is slowly falling apart here. White gives this one air, lands it on middle, Milton Shumba gets low and looks to slog sweep but he misses his shot as the ball crashes into the furniture behind. 95 needed in 59 balls!
Full and on middle, Shumba punches it straight down the ground towards long on. He retains the strike by picking up a single. 95 needed from 60 balls.
Loopy ball on middle, Ervine advances down the track and looks to clip it on the leg side. The ball goes off the outside edge towards point for one.
Full and on middle, drilled to long on for one.
Flatter ball on middle, Ervine pushes it towards point for a single.
SIX! BANG! This one is in the slot, on off. Craig Ervine smokes it over long on for a maximum.
Floated it up outside off, Shumba strokes it to deep cover for one.
A googly on off, Shumba pushes it to cover for a run.
A low full toss on off, Ervine drives it past cover for another single.
Full and outside off, Shumba pushes it to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
SIX! Easy pickings! Floated it up on off, Craig Ervine gets low and smacks it over wide of long on for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle, Shumba looks to tuck it around the corner but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
Short of a length, outside off. Ervine looks to cut it away but misses.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Fuller in length, on off. Craig Ervine drills it towards mid off. The fielder there runs to his right but fails to stop the ball. A boundary, in the end.
On a length, outside off. Shumba punches it to cover for one.
Length ball on middle, Ervine glances it to deep square leg for a run.

OUT! TAKEN! Short of a length, on off. Myers goes for the pull shot. He does not time it well though. The ball lands straight into the hands of Kevin O'Brien at deep mid-wicket and he completes the catch. Another one bites the dust for Zimbabwe as they lose their fourth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Kevin O'Brien b Shane Getkate

Commentary.Commentary: Milton Shumba walks out!
Good-length ball on off, Myers punches it back to the bowler.
Floated it up outside off, Ervine knocks it back to the bowler.
Outside off, worked to point for a single.
Full and on off, Ervine steps out and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball on middle, blocked out.
Craig Ervine is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Regis Chakabva is caught in the crease and looks to play across the line. He misses and gets hit on the pads. Benjamin White pleads for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger.
FOUR LEG BYES! Loopy ball down the leg side, Regis Chakabva looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball as well and it races away to the fine leg fence.
Benjamin White is introduced into the attack.
On a length on middle, Myers smashes it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. End of the Powerplay, Zimbabwe are 50/2.
Short of a length, on middle. Regis pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Beaten! Good-length ball, outside off, angling away. Regis Chakabva swings his bat hard but to no avail.
On a length, outside off. Myers guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball on off, Dion Myers steers it through covers for a boundary.
Good-length ball outside off, Regis Chakabva swings but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters sneak a bye. The keeper has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Length ball around off, Regis Chakabva works this through mid-wicket for one.
A touch short, around off, pulled to the left of deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, hit hard, but straight to the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Drilled! Fuller ball, outside off, Dion Myers whacks this one through mid off for a boundary.
Around off, on a good length, worked wide of square leg and the strike is exchanged.
Fullish ball, Myers drives this to the left of mid on for a run.
Shane Getkate is brought into the attack.
Outside off, length, left alone by Regis.
Dion Myers walks out to bat at No.4.

OUT! TAKEN! The skipper gets another catch and another Zimbabwean batter, who was looking good, perishes. Tadiwanashe Marumani looked to keep the boundaries rolling and his decision to go after any ball has proved to be his demise. On a length this time, around off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to loft this one over covers, but he only manages to chip this one towards extra cover, where Andy Balbirnie shows that he has safe hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: A little too straight, on middle, length delivery. Tadiwanashe Marumani goes back and whips this through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length on middle, flicked to the short fine leg fielder.
On off, defended out by Marumani.
Around off, on a length, whipped away aerially away from deep mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, TM misses his flick. Wided.
Josh Little comes into the attack. He replaces Mark Adair.

Darted on middle, Regis Chakabva goes back and works this wide of mid-wicket. They run one and decide to take the second. The throw comes to the keeper, who collects and whips the bails off, but the batter made it in. So, not out. 9 off Simi's first over!
Floated, outside off, Regis Chakabva looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal for LBW but turned down.
On middle again, hit down the ground for a single.
FOUR! Good shot. Fuller, floated, outside off, whacked past the cover fielder and the ball finds its way to the ropes.
Flatter, around off, worked to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Simi Singh comes into the attack. He replaces Paul Stirling.
Outside off, a touch short, Regis Chakabva looks to cut it away but only gets an underedge to the keeper.
Around off, this is played through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, outside off, this is punched hard through the cover region. Josh Little there dives to his right and half-stops the ball. Only two on this occasion.
Around off, on a length, guided through short third man for one.
Regis Chakabva is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The batting show by Wesley Madhevere comes to an unfortunate end. He looked very good in the first over but he gifts his wicket away on this occasion. Mark Adair gets a wicket in his very first over. On a length, around the off pole, Wesley Madhevere looks to heave this one over the off side but does not time it well. It goes high in the air towards covers, where the Irish skipper, Andy Balbirnie, pouches this.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye. Adair angles a length ball on the pads, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the off side for a leg bye.
Mark Adair to bowl from the opposite end.
14 from the first over! A touch flatter, around off, punched to covers for one.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries and Wesley has started with fire! Loopy again, on middle, Wesley Madhevere sweeps this one hard to the deep square leg fence.

FOUR! Wesley Madhevere has come out with attacking intent here. Floated, around off, Wesley Madhevere lofts this one over the mid off region and the ball takes a couple of bounces and goes past the ropes.

FOUR! Wesley Madhevere gets the first boundary of this innings. Tossed up, outside off, Wesley Madhevere moves to the off side and sweeps this one through square leg. Simi Singh runs to his right in the deep, but fails to stop this.
Tadiwanashe Marumani is off the mark on his first ball too! Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for one.
Wesley Madhevere and Zimbabwe open their accounts on ball one! Tossed up around off, this is eased through mid on for a single.
